candidate.definition_en: A soft yellow fat obtained from milk, used in cooking and on bread.
candidate.explanation_ar: الزبدة الصفرا اللي بنعملها من اللبن وبنحطها على العيش أو نطبخ بيها.

senses.definition_en: A soft yellow fat obtained from milk, used in cooking and on bread.
